name: Doppio Zero Garden Walk
address: R102 Shop 2 & 3, Garden Walk Mall, Hartenbos, 6520, South Africa
description_short: Contemporary Italian café in Garden Walk Mall serving fresh pizzas, pastas and all-day breakfast favourites.
description_long:
Doppio Zero Garden Walk brings the popular South African chain's signature Italian-inspired menu to Hartenbos. The relaxed café atmosphere makes it a reliable choice whether you're after a morning cappuccino and croissant, a wood-fired pizza for lunch, or fresh pasta for dinner.

The menu covers all the bases with generous salads, gourmet burgers, and their well-known selection of artisan breads baked fresh daily. Families appreciate the kids' menu and casual vibe, while the all-day breakfast means you can order eggs Benedict well past noon. Located in Garden Walk Mall along the R102, it's a convenient stop for locals and visitors exploring the Hartenbos area.

Service is generally friendly and efficient, though peak times can get busy. The indoor seating suits Mossel Bay's sometimes windy days, and there's decent parking at the mall. It's a solid choice when you want familiar favourites done well without any fuss.
